talking_points: Alibaba's new Zhenwu V900 chip and 20-gigawatt cloud plan show China racing to match Nvidia on AI infrastructure.
AMD just joined the trillion-dollar club, but Meta's Muse and Google's Gemini both had serious AI agent security failures this week.
The AI IPO wave is hitting turbulence, with Nscale's loss-making $50bn listing and SB Energy's delayed float raising fresh valuation doubts.
